sharedPrompt: Create a premium editorial 3D still-life for an individual open-source project card. Use a coherent Moonlit visual family: warm ivory background, soft natural shadows, tactile ceramic and paper, restrained navy and brushed copper with a small sage accent. Landscape 4:3 composition, recognizable at small thumbnail size, centered with generous margins; keep the lower 18 percent visually quiet for a website caption overlay. Static single still. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, screenshot, or copied characters.
captionPolicy: Render project name and a concise plain-language purpose as HTML over the image. Never ask the image model to draw labels or rely on the illustration alone to explain the tool.
